versions.changelog:
bolta-skills-index 2.0.1

- Updated metadata with new trusted domain (`mcp.bolta.ai`) and endpoint definitions.
- Added detailed documentation for Bolta API key types (regular vs agent), scopes, and security implications.
- Clarified permission handling and agent roles for skill access and orchestration.
- Linked to additional related repositories and API documentation resources.
- No code logic or interface changes; documentation and metadata focused update.
Skills are now in alignment wit h the BoltaClaw (Our version of OpenClaw) and able to interact properly with your agents on Bolta. You can create agents and jobs now too.

- Metadata section added at the top with structured details on environment variables, permissions, dependencies, and trusted domains.
- Visual security notice and checklist for credential and workspace verification introduced.
- Clear guidance on credential management, rotation, scoping, and monitoring with dedicated best practices section.
- No core functionality changes; documentation and security posture strengthened.
- All previous setup, usage, and troubleshooting instructions remain and are reorganized/clarified.
- Documentation updated with a new "Installation & First Run" section at the end of SKILL.md.

No file changes were detected in this release (0.5.2).

- Internal version bump; documentation and code remain unchanged from 0.5.1.
- No impact on existing workflows or functionality.

## bolta-skills-index v0.5.1

- Added explicit documentation about required environment variables: `BOLTA_API_KEY`, `BOLTA_WORKSPACE_ID`, and optionally `BOLTA_AGENT_ID`
- Provided security best practices for API key storage and rotation
- Updated setup instructions with concrete examples for various environments (CLI, Node.js, Claude Desktop MCP)
- Clarified trusted domains and pre-installation checklist
- No code changes or functionality updates—documentation and setup requirements only

Version 0.5.0 introduces agent API setup instructions and troubleshooting to improve onboarding:

- Added a comprehensive "Getting Started: Agent API Setup" section, including agent registration, environment configuration, and permissions guidance.
- Included detailed troubleshooting steps for common API authentication and permission errors.
- Provided step-by-step workflow for first-time users: from API setup to initial skill use and workspace policy configuration.
- Main skill architecture and description unchanged from previous version.

**Major update: Bolta Skills Registry now offers comprehensive skill discovery, compatibility, and orchestration for workspace onboarding and management.**

- Rewritten purpose: Registry now includes full discovery, install set recommendation, orchestration, compatibility, and bootstrapping guidance.
- New “planes” structure: Skills grouped into Voice, Content, Review, Automation, and Control planes, with detailed purpose and core principles for each.
- Expanded skill index: Skills now include new listings (e.g., content repurposing, thread creation, recurring posts, trending topic response, compliance checks, quota status).
- Each skill entry now includes: Path, purpose, inputs, outputs, permissions, Safe Mode compatibility, and typical usage/duration.
- Detailed usage scenarios and flows: Onboarding, troubleshooting, workflow planning, and team governance are now described.
- Enforces compatibility checks, quota enforcement, and autonomy/safety guardrails in registry recommendations.

- Introduced the Bolta Skills Registry as a centralized, structured index of all Bolta skills.
- Skills are grouped by operational plane (Voice, Content, Review, Automation, Control) with descriptions and file references.
- Provides workspace-based “Recommended install sets” for Assisted, Managed Automation, Autopilot, and Governance modes.
- Orchestrates skill discovery and installation guidance; does not perform content operations itself.
- Includes clear guidance for importing skills and accessing each skill’s full documentation.
